<thought>Based on the spectrum, a clear M+1 peak at +1 Da with ~16 % intensity indicates the presence of many carbon atoms (≈15 C). An M+2 peak at +2 Da with ~4–5 % intensity is characteristic of a single sulfur atom (34S ≈4 %). No ~33 % M+2 (chlorine) or ~100 % M+2 (bromine) patterns are observed. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and sulfur.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
